test_title: PYST 71: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select a figure from the answer set the contents of which may best substitute the question marks in problems at such that figure III is related to figure IV in the same way as figure I is related to figure II.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92c1dffea2763f884469d1b68de09e07cf9d53517c3f09ed6537f165f0c09651.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** The relationship is based on the number of line segments forming each figure. In the first pair, a **square (4 line segments)** is paired with an open figure made of **3 line segments**, showing a pattern of **n : n − 1**. The same relationship must be maintained in the second pair.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/988a5584df7a8d263fbb5e39b344a9b0d100230037a1b84f244f4c4e3b77c22e.png] 

Now, checking the Options:

**Option 1:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3af9dc5c2d327eab3b315bb2f71b94945c312f55ddc236cb1f9fa4b0b9a49b61.png] 

Mismatch in the required 4 : 3 and 3 : 2 structure → Does not follow the rule

**Option 2:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b98b3c1eddf7b135d7583b311648e342ee879a763488ecb6f57b875797772ec0.png] 

Does not maintain the consistent reduction of one line segment → Breaks the rule

**Option 3:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d1847543bea1ec425f897328feda92f60a2eb8099c6eda810eb311085206a6b.png] 

Square (4 lines) paired with 3-line figure, and triangle (3 lines) paired with 2-line angle → Follows the rule (4 : 3 :: 3 : 2)

**Option 4:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a92f7b9b922d246e8940db41cbbb4a842607777d37b6a41541d4c4fd8efa955c.png] 

Does not maintain the required line segment progression → Breaks the rule

Hence, **Option 3** is the correct answer.
